note: Attacker-controlled TCP payload length is derived from the IP total-length field (payload_packet_len = 1 for a 41-byte packet with a 1-byte payload). No lower bound of 4 is enforced here.
payload pointer is placed at the very end of the packet buffer (offset 40 of 41), so payload[1..3] are beyond the buffer end.
Amazon Video dissector is dispatched for the TCP packet with payload because the protocol was not detected yet.
Magic-byte comparison indexes payload[0..3] without first verifying payload_packet_len >= 4; with a 1-byte payload the chain proceeds past the end of the buffer.
OOB read of payload[1] one byte past the 41-byte packet buffer (payload_packet_len == 1): heap-buffer-overflow READ of size 1.
